exposure: large language models (LLMs) applied to prenatal clinical notes
LLM-extracted features combined with structured data
outcome: postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) defined by estimated or quantitative blood loss (EBL-QBL)
postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) defined by a clinical intervention-based definition (cPPH)
cohort: The study included 19,992 deliveries from a large regional health network.
finding: LLM-based direct prediction models achieved the highest performance in predicting PPH (AUROC 0.79-0.80) compared to models using only structured data or combined LLM-extracted features.
mod_finding: Previous cesarean delivery was identified as a significant predictor of PPH by the LLM-extracted features approach.
